description: Builds a link to the program's Jotform with the person's answers filled in and, if given, the week and the pay-in-full / deposit choice preselected. This does NOT enroll, reserve a seat or charge anything: the person must open the link, check the answers, accept the waivers, pay and submit on the form. Answers are not stored or logged. Use keys from get_enrollment_form; unknown keys and invalid answers are returned in `skipped`, required questions not yet answered in `missingRequired` (they can still answer them on the form), and answers to confirm with the person before handing over the link in `warnings`.

answers.description: Question key → answer. Addresses are objects; everything else is a string.

paymentOption.description: One of the week's paymentOptions labels, e.g. 'Pay Deposit'.

productId.description: A week from get_enrollment_form. Omit to let them pick on the form.

name: build_enrollment_link
title: Build a prefilled enrollment form link
